en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4281 - Uthman ibn Isa narrated from Abu Ayyub, from Abu Abdillah (as), who said:
"Do not swear by Allah (swt), whether truthfully or falsely, for Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious, has forbidden that, as He (swt), the Almighty, says:
'And do not make Allah (swt) an excuse in your oaths' (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:224)."
